repair.cause: OpenPencil 0.16.0 headless singleton retained ID-keyed vector/fill/stroke path caches across unrelated FIG readbacks with reused node IDs. Source vectors and FIG dimensions were not the cause.
repair.fix: Repository-owned render-isolated.mjs gives every graph its own renderer and disposes all graph/path caches afterwards.
repair.checks: Triangle/square same-ID counterexample reproduces upstream corruption; isolated square has correct black lower-right pixel and is independent of render order. All 65 new previews regenerated and all four contact sheets visually inspected; Tooltip also inspected full-size.
repair.nativeFigFiles: Preserved unchanged; no manual hiding, deleting or reshaping of source geometry.
